mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cluster_datasync_task (id, host, data_json, task_type, status, url, current_time_millis ) VALUES( #{id}, #{host}, #{dataJson}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{url}, #{currentTimeMillis} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, host, data_json as dataJson, task_type as taskType, status, url, current_time_millis as currentTimeMillis FROM cluster_datasync_task where host=#{host} and status=#{status} order by current_time_millis
